purpose: Requirements for the ToC: managed document information, AI-generated field limits, change detection by hashes, and the build and rebuild flow with candidate validation and atomic commit.
summary: Information requirements for ToC document entries, section entries and reference entries, with acquisition methods
Only DLIDs may be written to user documents; no manual ID numbering or duplicate metadata
Limits on AI-generated fields (purpose 200 characters, arrays 10 items) and the internal tolerance H = floor(L x 1.3) that must never be shown to the generating AI
ToC metadata: key and normalized Index target specification, with rebuild detection when the specification changes
Change detection (FR-003, FR-011, FR-012): new, body change, reference change, move/rename, removal from index target, unchanged
Content hash definition: SHA-256 of raw text excluding reference link definition lines; 12-character recorded form in link titles
ToC build and rebuild in three stages with update plan, reuse of existing AI fields, and reference check state reconstruction
Candidate validation and atomic commit; failure keeps the last committed ToC
Build result returns counts on stdout and full details in a work file
Acceptance criteria AC-001, AC-002, AC-010, AC-011, AC-017, AC-018, AC-020, AC-026, AC-027
tasks: Designing or implementing ToC build and rebuild
Implementing change detection between ToC and current documents

Implementing AI-generated field generation and validation limits

Implementing the index-docs skill and its result output
Reviewing ToC-related requirements and acceptance criteria
Writing tests for rebuild, move/rename and hash behavior
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — [ToC]管理
